opening.text: Years ago I was deployed to East Africa, and four months in, I came under enemy gunfire. For malaria prevention, I took mefloquine 250 mg once a week and kept taking it for six months. It started about two weeks after I began taking mefloquine, with anxiety and vivid dreams. Since I came back, I've had mood swings; I get angry and irritable. I have trouble concentrating. I have persistent 'sea legs', a feeling as if I'm on a boat, and on top of that, I feel a constant spinning dizziness. I get attacks of vertigo, each one lasts 20 to 30 minutes, and I've been falling.
